description: Saved-data comparison: direct six-point plumbing series with the existing separately integrated four-point collar retained.
scope: All 15 current energies, 8 shared scrambles and 256 points per scramble. Replace all 4950 nome-based pointwise evaluations by their saved C12 direct values. Preserve all existing C13-C18 refinements, momenta, weights, samples, and the analytic four-point collar addback.
four_point_completion_scope: The strict variant also removes the 101 primary-face-nome evaluations. It keeps the separately integrated four-point collar. The secondary variant retains those 101 boundary completions including their transformed finite corrections; it is not a complete elimination of general nome transformations.
limits: This is a reduction of saved finite-order evaluations. No new conformal-block coefficients or momentum integrals were computed. The direct values at reverted points stop at C12. Small amplitude shifts and prefix increments are not bounds on omitted higher levels or other systematic errors.
amplitude_convention: mu^4 A = i I6/(8 pi^3); relative changes are independent of the fixed amplitude normalization.
